title: How deep is the tree?
hints: Base case: a `Num` is one level deep, so `case Num(_): return 1`.
For an `Add` or `Mul`, find the depth of each child with a recursive call.
The node adds one level on top of its deeper child: `return 1 + max(depth(left), depth(right))`. An or-pattern `case Add(left, right) | Mul(left, right):` covers both classes.
explain: The reference matches on the node. A Num is depth 1. An Add or Mul is 1 plus the larger of its children's depths, found by recursive calls. Adding the two depths instead of taking the max counts the whole tree rather than its longest path, and the balanced test catches that.
